queries:
WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean
  FROM per_rating
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT p.rating,
       p.avg_ratio AS average,
       p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean
FROM per_rating p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
  AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean
ORDER BY p.rating;

assumptions.assumption: Ratings with no film having replacement_cost >= 20.99 do not appear as groups, so they do not enter the overall mean. The overall mean is the unweighted mean of the per-rating averages, not a film-level average. rental_duration is never 0 (verified range 3-7), so there is no division by zero.

assumptions.assumption: Films with replacement_cost >= 20.99 form the population; the per-film ratio is rental_rate / rental_duration, computed with decimal (non-integer) division, and rental_duration = 0 is excluded to avoid division by zero (none exist per the verified data).
The overall mean is the unweighted mean of the per-rating averages (not weighted by film count), as the request states 'simple mean'.
